strings.app.name: Mourse Decoder
strings.calibration.intro: Key a few presses as asked and the program suggests timing values that fit your rhythm. Nothing is changed until you press Apply. While measuring, nothing is typed.
strings.calibration.hint.dot: Press the Morse key briefly {n} times, the way you key a dot.
strings.calibration.hint.dash: Press the Morse key {n} times, the way you key a dash.
strings.calibration.hint.letter: Press once to start. Then press {n} more times, each after the pause you leave between two letters.
strings.calibration.hint.word: Press once to start. Then press {n} more times, each after the pause you leave between two words.
strings.calibration.state.idle: Press Start to measure. Nothing is typed while measuring.
strings.calibration.state.done: All steps are done. Check the suggested values below.
strings.calibration.separate_note: A separate dash key is set, so only the pauses are measured.
strings.calibration.result.title: Suggested values
strings.calibration.hint.rhythm: Key the presses one right after the other, as inside one letter: the pauses between them limit the letter pause.
strings.calibration.timeout: Measuring stopped by itself after 10 minutes. The results so far are kept.
strings.calibration.not_running: Morse input is not running, so nothing can be measured.
strings.calibration.ignored: {n} very short press(es) or pause(s) (under 20 ms) were ignored as contact bounce.
strings.calibration.disabled_note: Morse input is switched off. Measuring works anyway, but the key is not blocked and does its normal job.
strings.calibration.apply.failed: Not applied: the settings were refused. Check the settings page.
strings.calibration.nothing: There is nothing to apply yet.
strings.calibration.issue.too_few_dot: Too few dots: at least 3 usable presses are needed.
strings.calibration.issue.too_few_dash: Too few dashes: at least 3 usable presses are needed.
strings.calibration.issue.dots_dashes_overlap: Dots and dashes are not distinguishable: the dashes are not clearly longer than the dots. Press the dashes longer.
strings.calibration.issue.too_few_letter: Too few letter pauses: at least 3 usable ones are needed.
strings.calibration.issue.too_few_word: Too few word pauses: at least 3 usable ones are needed.
strings.calibration.issue.words_not_longer: The word pauses are not clearly longer than the letter pauses.
strings.calibration.issue.word_needs_letter: The word pause needs usable letter pauses first.
strings.calibration.issue.clamped_threshold: The suggested {wanted} ms is outside the allowed range of {low} to {high} ms, so {value} ms is suggested.
strings.calibration.issue.clamped_letter: The suggested {wanted} ms is outside the allowed range of {low} to {high} ms, so {value} ms is suggested.
strings.calibration.issue.clamped_word: The suggested {wanted} ms is outside the allowed range of {low} to {high} ms, so {value} ms is suggested.
strings.calibration.issue.threshold_unusable: No dot/dash threshold can be suggested: {wanted} ms would be outside {low} to {high} ms and not between the dot time ({dot} ms) and the dash time ({dash} ms).
strings.calibration.issue.letter_raised: The letter pause was raised to {value} ms: your pauses inside a letter reach {inner} ms, and the letter pause has to be clearly longer.
strings.calibration.issue.letter_too_close: No letter pause can be suggested: your pauses inside a letter ({inner} ms) are too close to your pauses between letters ({letter} ms). Key the symbols of a letter faster.
strings.calibration.issue.word_was_off: The word pause is switched off now. Applying the suggestion turns it on with {value} ms.
strings.calibration.issue.word_raised: The new letter pause ({letter} ms) would reach the word pause ({old} ms), so the word pause is raised to {value} ms as well.
strings.calibration.issue.threshold_overlaps: Some of your dots and dashes overlap: the threshold {value} ms is not between your longest dot ({dot_max} ms) and your shortest dash ({dash_min} ms), so some presses will be read the wrong way. Key dots and dashes more clearly apart.
strings.calibration.issue.letter_pauses_shorter: Some of your letter pauses (shortest {low} ms) are shorter than the suggested {value} ms: those letters would run together. Keep your pauses between letters more even.
strings.calibration.issue.letter_below_range: No letter pause can be suggested: your letter pauses (about {letter} ms) are not longer than the smallest allowed letter pause ({low} ms).
strings.translator.hint: Type text to see it as Morse code. Alphabet: {alphabet}.
strings.settings.block.hint: While Morse input is on, the Morse key no longer types or clicks by itself, only the decoded text arrives
strings.settings.shortcut.hint: Click, hold modifiers, press the last key
strings.settings.undo_shortcut.hint: Deletes the last typed output. Click, hold modifiers, press the last key
strings.settings.input.hint: Turns typing into other programs on or off
strings.settings.key.hint: Click the button, then press a key, mouse button or combination (e.g. hold Caps Lock and press Q).
strings.settings.dash.hint: Off: a short press is a dot, a long one a dash. On: the Morse key always gives a dot, the dash key always a dash.
strings.settings.dash_key.hint: Only used when a separate dash key is switched on
strings.settings.alphabet.hint: Character set the Morse codes are translated into
strings.settings.smileys.hint: Extra codes for smileys (JSON files, see the Smileys page)
strings.settings.notify.hint: A small, quiet message when the shortcut turns Morse input on or off
strings.settings.theme.hint: Light is soft white with light gray and charcoal, dark is anthracite
strings.timing.dot.hint: Shorter than this is a dot, longer is a dash
strings.timing.letter.hint: Silence after which a letter is complete
strings.timing.word.hint: Silence until a space is typed. 0 disables spaces.
strings.timing.typing.hint: Pause after each typed character, 0 to 10000 ms. Raise it if a program drops or scrambles letters; very low values can do that too.
strings.backup.export.hint: All settings, function keys and your own alphabets, smileys and languages as one zip. The zip can hold secrets (paths, macro texts): keep it private.
strings.backup.import.hint: Restores a zip made by Export. A restore point of your current files is saved first.
strings.backup.telecode.ask: A Chinese telecode database (telecode.sqlite) exists. Include it? It is large and only rebuildable with the Unihan download.
strings.backup.export.done:
{count} files saved to {path}.

The zip can contain secrets such as paths and macro texts. Keep it private.
strings.backup.import.nothing: Everything in this backup is already in place. Nothing to do.
strings.backup.import.confirm:
Backup from version {version}, created {created} (UTC).

New: {add}, replaced: {replace}, unchanged: {unchanged}. Files that are not in the backup stay as they are.

{files}

{extra}Import now?
strings.backup.import.done:
Backup imported and active now.

Your previous files are in the restore point:
{path}
(import that zip to undo.)
strings.backup.restore_point: Restore point with your previous files: {path}
strings.backup.import.choice:
Yes: import everything
No: import without the files that contain macros or commands (function_keys.json, alphabets, smiley sets and telecode.sqlite with commands; everything else is imported)
Cancel: import nothing
strings.backup.import.warn.macros: WARNING: this backup brings {count} function key macro(s) that type text and press keys as soon as their trigger is used. A macro can start programs, open files or type what is on the clipboard. Import only backups you made yourself or got from a source you trust completely.
strings.backup.import.warn.risky: Commands that act outside the typed text: {commands}.
strings.backup.import.apply_failed: The files were imported, but the running program could not load them ({reason}). Restart the program now: until then, changes made in the program can overwrite the imported files.
strings.backup.import.skipfile.ask: {name} cannot be used. Import everything else without it?
strings.backup.import.safe: Without the files that have macros or commands ({files}) this adds {add} and replaces {replace} files.
strings.backup.import.safe_error: Importing without those files is not possible: {error}
strings.backup.import.warn.commands: WARNING: {count} entries of this backup contain commands or control characters. In alphabet and smiley files they run when their code is keyed (key combinations, files, the clipboard); in telecode.sqlite they are only typed as text, but the program does not write such a database. Import only backups you trust completely.
strings.backup.import.removed: {count} file(s) that the import had created were removed.
strings.backup.change_dropped: A change you made while the import was running was not applied to the imported settings. Please make it again.
strings.backup.warn.alphabet_missing: The alphabet "{name}" will not exist after the import; the program will use Latin.
strings.backup.warn.smileys_missing: The smiley set "{name}" will not exist after the import; smileys will be off.
strings.backup.warn.language_missing: The language "{name}" will not exist after the import; English will be used.
strings.backup.warn.settings_keys: settings.json changes the Morse key, the blocking or the shortcuts of the program ({fields}). If you do not know this backup, check them before you confirm.
strings.backup.warn.languages_custom: This backup brings or selects a language that does not ship with the program ({names}). A language file can change what labels say in the program; the warnings of this dialog always use the built-in texts. Import it only if you know where it comes from.
strings.backup.warn.telecode_missing: The Chinese telecode alphabet is chosen, but telecode.sqlite is neither in the backup nor in your folder; the program will use Latin until you add it.
strings.backup.warn.file_skipped: {name} is not a usable file ({reason}); the program will skip it.
strings.backup.quit_wait: An import is running. The program closes when it is finished.
strings.backup.err.nothing_to_back_up: There is nothing to back up: the config folder has no settings or user files.
strings.backup.err.folder_too_large: The config folder is too large for a backup bundle.
strings.backup.err.file_too_large_export: {name} is larger than {limit}, so a backup could not import it again.
strings.backup.err.zip_unreadable: {name} is not a readable zip file: {error}
strings.backup.err.entry_size_mismatch: {name}: the size in the zip does not match its content.
strings.backup.err.too_many_entries: The zip has more than {count} entries.
strings.backup.err.backslash: Backslashes are not allowed in names in the zip: {name}
strings.backup.err.folder_entry: Unexpected folder entry in the zip: {name}
strings.backup.err.bad_name: Unexpected or unsafe name in the zip: {name}
strings.backup.err.total_too_large: The zip holds more than {limit} when unpacked.
strings.backup.err.not_a_backup: manifest.json does not describe a Mourse Decoder backup.
strings.backup.err.format_version: Unknown backup format version {version}; this program reads version {supported}.
strings.backup.err.manifest_files: manifest.json has no valid file list.
strings.backup.err.manifest_missing: manifest.json is missing, this is not a Mourse Decoder backup.
strings.backup.err.manifest_bad_name: manifest.json lists an unexpected or unsafe name: {name}
strings.backup.err.manifest_missing_file: {name} is listed in manifest.json but missing in the zip.
strings.backup.err.checksum: {name} does not match its checksum; the zip is damaged or was changed.
strings.backup.err.unlisted: The zip holds files that manifest.json does not list: {name}
strings.backup.err.newer_version: {name} comes from a newer program version (schema_version {version}, this one knows {supported}). Update the program first.
strings.backup.err.sqlite_schema: {name} has no telecode table with the columns code and char.
strings.backup.err.sqlite_values: {name} has {count} entries whose code or character is not text.
strings.backup.err.clash: The function keys and the settings would clash: {details}
strings.backup.err.not_a_plain_file: {name} in the config folder is not a plain file, nothing was changed.
strings.backup.err.cannot_read_current: Cannot read {name} in the config folder: {error}
strings.backup.err.check_failed: The check of the backup failed: {error}
strings.backup.err.changed_after_check: The zip file changed after it was checked. Nothing was imported; choose it again.
strings.backup.err.link_folder: {name} in the config folder is a link, nothing was changed.
strings.backup.err.outside_folder: {name} would be written outside the config folder, nothing was changed.
strings.backup.err.write_failed: Writing {name} failed ({error}); the config folder was left as it was.
strings.backup.err.write_failed_partial: Writing {name} failed ({error}). These files could not be put back and may be in the imported state: {files}.
strings.backup.err.write_failed_partial_point: Writing {name} failed ({error}). These files could not be put back and may be in the imported state: {files}. Your previous files are in the restore point {restore_point}; import that zip to repair them.
strings.backup.err.busy: An import is running. Try again when it is finished.
strings.backup.err.sqlite_unexpected: {name} holds something the program does not use ({what}); only the table telecode is allowed.
strings.backup.err.settings_bad_id: settings.json: {field} is no valid id ({value}); an id is a file name (a-z, 0-9, - and _).
strings.key.hint.waiting: Press the key or mouse button you want to use. For a combination, hold e.g. Caps Lock or Ctrl first. Esc cancels.
strings.key.unsupported: {key} is not supported. Choose another key.
strings.key.err.native: Reading keys needs the native module (run maturin develop)
strings.alpha.empty: Select, import or create an alphabet
strings.startup.alphabet_fallback: Alphabet '{id}' could not be loaded ({msg}); using 'latin'.
strings.startup.bad_alphabet_id: settings.json: "{value}" is not a valid alphabet ID (allowed: a-z, 0-9, "-" and "_"). The program uses "{default}" instead; choose the alphabet again on the settings page.
strings.startup.bad_smiley_id: settings.json: "{value}" is not a valid smiley set ID (allowed: a-z, 0-9, "-" and "_"). The program uses no smiley set instead; choose one again on the Smileys page.
strings.startup.settings_discarded: settings.json could not be used ({reason}). The program starts with the default settings; the file is kept as settings.json.bak.
strings.startup.keys_fallback: The keyboard module refused the keys in settings.json ({reason}). The default keys are used; the file is kept as settings.json.bak.
strings.app.already_running: Mourse Decoder is already running (see the tray icon).
strings.alpha.status.builtin: Built-in and read-only. Use “Create copy” to change it.
strings.alpha.status.new: Adjust id, name and codes, then click Save. “extends” inherits digits and punctuation.
strings.alpha.status.copy: Change id and name if needed, then click Save
strings.alpha.status.json_ok: JSON is valid ({n} own codes). The full check happens on save.
strings.alpha.dlg.discard.title: Unsaved changes
strings.alpha.dlg.delete.title: Delete
strings.alpha.dlg.delete.own: Only your own alphabets can be deleted
strings.alpha.dlg.delete.active: The active alphabet cannot be deleted
strings.smiley.none.desc: Only the characters of the alphabet are typed
strings.smiley.status: {n} codes. On identical codes the alphabet takes priority.
strings.smiley.dlg.delete.own: Only your own smiley sets can be deleted
strings.smiley.dlg.delete.active: The active smiley set cannot be deleted
strings.live.hint:
Key {key}, alphabet {alphabet}, input {state}.
Press briefly (under {dot} ms) for a dot, longer for a dash. A pause of {gap} ms completes the letter.
strings.live.hint.two_keys:
Dot key {key}, dash key {dash_key}, alphabet {alphabet}, input {state}.
A pause of {gap} ms completes the letter.
strings.game.title: Battleship
strings.game.status.setup: Shuffle your fleet until you like it, then press Start
strings.game.status.you: Your turn: click a square in enemy waters
strings.game.bot.sunk: The enemy sunk one of your ships!
strings.game.win: You win! The enemy fleet is gone
strings.game.lose: You lose. Your fleet is gone.
strings.credits.tagline: Decode Morse code anywhere – as keyboard input in any program
strings.credits.donate.text: If Mourse Decoder is useful to you, a small donation keeps development going. Thank you!
strings.update.only_exe: Installing by itself only works with the downloaded MourseDecoder.exe. The release page was opened instead.
strings.uninstall.title: Remove completely
strings.uninstall.hint: Deletes the program, and its data if you want
strings.uninstall.confirm.title: Uninstall
strings.uninstall.confirm:
Really uninstall Mourse Decoder?

The program (MourseDecoder.exe) will be deleted. You will then be asked whether your own files should be deleted too.

This cannot be undone.
strings.uninstall.data.title: Own files
strings.uninstall.data:
Also delete your own files (settings, cache, JSON files)?

Folders:
{folders}

Yes: delete the program and the files
No: delete only the program
Cancel: delete nothing
strings.update.result.title: Update
strings.update.result.busy: The last update did not run: the old program file stayed in use. The old version was started again. Close other copies and the virus scanner, then try again.
strings.update.result.start: The update was installed, but the new program could not be started. Start MourseDecoder.exe by hand.
strings.update.result.uninstall: The last uninstall was not complete: some files could not be deleted. Remove them by hand.
strings.update.result.reparse: The last uninstall skipped a folder because it is a link (junction or symlink) and not a real folder. Check it and delete it by hand.
strings.update.result.verify: The last update did not run: the downloaded file was changed after it had been checked. The old version was started again. Nothing was installed; download the update again.
strings.update.result.rollback: The last update failed and could not be undone. MourseDecoder.exe may be damaged or unchecked, so nothing was started. Do not run it. Install the program again from the release page of the project; the old version may still be next to it as MourseDecoder.exe.old.
strings.update.result.unknown: The last update or uninstall did not finish.
strings.update.err.rate_limit: GitHub has limited the requests from this network for now. Try again in an hour.
strings.update.err.ssl: The secure connection to GitHub failed. Check the date and time, the proxy and the virus scanner.
strings.update.err.no_checksum: Release {tag} has no checksum (MourseDecoder.exe.sha256), so nothing is installed. Do not download this release by hand: wait for a corrected release or ask the maintainer.
strings.update.err.no_signature: Release {tag} has no signature (MourseDecoder.exe.sig), so nothing is installed. Do not download this release by hand: wait for a corrected release or ask the maintainer.
strings.update.err.bad_signature: The signature of the downloaded update does not match. The update was deleted and not installed.
strings.update.err.no_pinned_key: This version of the program contains no key for checking update signatures, so it installs no updates. Download the new version by hand.
strings.update.err.no_write: No permission to write in the folder {folder}. Run the program from a folder you can write to, or download the update by hand.
strings.update.err.no_powershell: PowerShell could not be started ({detail}). The update runs through it.
strings.update.err.not_newer: Release {tag} is not newer than the installed version {current}. Nothing is installed.
strings.update.err.file_too_large: The file {name} is much larger than expected. Nothing is installed.
strings.settings.cycle_shortcut.hint: Click, hold modifiers, press the last key
strings.cycle.empty: No alphabet in the list. Pick some in the settings.
strings.undo.modifiers: Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win are still held.
strings.import.risky.title: Commands in the file
strings.functionkeys.hint: F13 to F24 are real keys. F25 to F100 are virtual slots: each has a long key combination as its trigger, which a Stream Deck button can send. Pressing Esc stops a running macro.
strings.functionkeys.readonly: function_keys.json comes from a newer version. The slots are shown, but changes are not saved.
strings.functionkeys.label: Label
strings.functionkeys.delay.hint: Pause after each character in ms (0 to 10000). Empty = the value from the settings. A Delay in the macro wins.
strings.functionkeys.enabled.hint: When off, the slot does nothing
strings.functionkeys.swallow.hint: Hides the trigger from the program in front. Other keys are never touched.
strings.functionkeys.swallow.linux: Not available on Linux, the key always reaches the program
strings.functionkeys.macro.help: Same language as alphabet codes. Example: {example} types 0 1 2.
strings.functionkeys.reset.title: Reset slot
strings.functionkeys.reset.confirm: Reset {name} to its default trigger and delete its macro?
strings.functionkeys.discard.title: Unsaved changes
strings.functionkeys.test.wait: {name} runs in {s} s. Click into the target window now.
strings.functionkeys.macro.escape: A brace as plain text needs a backslash in front: {brace}
strings.functionkeys.macro.repeat: Repeat a key: {first} or {second} (count 1 to 1000, after a space).
strings.functionkeys.macro.delay: Pause between characters from here on: {delay} (0 to 10000 ms, until the next {delay} or the end). Plain pause: {wait}. Delete what was typed before: {rollback}.
